title: trema macrophyllum
intro: Trema macrophyllum, commonly known as Liane, is a climbing plant species belonging to the family Cannabaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional medicine, where it is used to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce pain and inflammation, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Trema macrophyllum include its ability to act as an analgesic, antipyretic, and antiseptic, making it a useful remedy for treating fever, wounds, and other health issues. The bioactive constituents of Trema macrophyllum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
